message.abstract: <jats:p>In this work, we investigate task-adaptive asymmetric loss calibration for lightweight corrosion segmentation using a CBAM-enhanced MobileNetV2 U-Net. First, we compare DiceCE with a reference Focal Tversky-based loss and observe that the latter produces a strongly precision-oriented behavior, substantially reducing corrosion recall and overall overlap. Motivated by this limitation, we propose the Industrial Defect Asymmetric Loss (IDAL), which systematically adjusts the asymmetric weighting of the Focal Tversky component to identify a task-specific precision–recall operating point. The selected configuration is further evaluated using multi-seed experiments and five-fold cross-validation. IDAL achieves comparable corrosion IoU and Dice to DiceCE (0.498 vs. 0.497 and 0.665 vs. 0.664), while improving precision (0.637 vs. 0.583), Boundary IoU (0.114 vs. 0.104), and HD95 (45.924 vs. 48.879). This benefit is accompanied by reduced recall (0.695 vs. 0.774). A limitation is that the evaluation is conducted on a single corrosion dataset.</jats:p>
